comment: Single source of truth for the artifact's covered contents. It is itself signed and inventoried, so it cannot be quietly widened. The inventory hashes every file under root_files (those that exist) and skill_dirs (recursively, any type). nono per-file signing covers root_files, the inventory, and skill_dirs/**/*.<skill_extensions>. build-inventory.py, verify_artifact.py, lib/common.sh and ci/sign-skills.yml all derive from this file.
